title: The farm key with a blank tag
body: A county map has a route drawn to the farm gate, then cut short at the fence. The key tag is blank; its metal ring is flattened at the join.
rival_reading: A program worker could keep a spare gate key with an unfinished tag and mark a route for field access; the map does not prove a containment failure.
gloss: A farm access route stops at a fence while its spare key has no identifying tag.

title: A field check with no planting day
body: The bottle is half full of clear water. A pressed clover leaf marks a notebook page of plot checks, but the planting-date line is empty.
rival_reading: A response crew could survey a farm after a diversion and leave the planting line blank; a leaf and water bottle do not show an agricultural malfunction.
gloss: A farm notebook pairs an unfinished plot check with a water bottle and a pressed leaf.
